title: The C.C.D. Data-Taking System
version: University of California Lick Observatory Technical Report 28, August 1981.
lineage: Lick Observatory's scan of the report. The title page and introduction were read using OCR.

passages.note: Lauer documents an August 1981 configuration on PDP-8 computers, originally operating with a 500 × 500 Texas Instruments CCD. The report describes acquisition, readout and image storage.
